name: Cash Collateral 4
definition: Provides details about the cash posted as collateral.

AssetNumber.name: Asset Number
AssetNumber.definition: Identifies the register number of the collateral deposit assigned by the central counterparty.

DepositType.name: Deposit Type
DepositType.definition: Specifies whether the deposit is fixed term or call/notice.

BlockedAmount.name: Blocked Amount
BlockedAmount.definition: Amount blocked by the central counterparty for any reasonable reason ( for example for judicial reasons). In this case the investor can not withdraw or distribute this collateral.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Planned final repayment date at the time of issuance.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Valuation date of the cash taken as collateral.

CollateralValue.name: Collateral Value
CollateralValue.definition: Value of the collateral after taking into account the haircut.

Haircut.name: Haircut
Haircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the collateral expressed as a percentage.
